principles.title: Public truth outranks presentation
principles.rule: A public interface MUST NOT strengthen, broaden or upgrade a claim beyond the evidence and scope available to the underlying record.

principles.title: Publication is not the source of truth
principles.rule: A publication MAY interpret records, but it MUST NOT become the canonical authority for facts that belong to systems, experiments, claims or evidence.

principles.title: Evidence is not a claim
principles.rule: An artifact, commit, test, deployment, endpoint, document, witness or dataset MUST NOT determine its own conclusion merely by existing.

principles.title: Claim is not evidence
principles.rule: A claim MUST NOT be treated as self-validating. Claims that require support MUST be able to reference the evidence, observations or prior claims that support them.

principles.title: Questions may remain open
principles.rule: An unanswered question is a valid public knowledge state. The system MUST permit questions to remain open, partially answered or superseded without manufacturing closure.

principles.title: Unknown remains unknown
principles.rule: Absence of evidence MUST NOT be converted into success, failure, safety, correctness or any other conclusion by inference alone.

principles.title: System is not publication
principles.rule: A durable system identity MUST exist independently of any article, essay, case study or research note written about it.

principles.title: Experiment is not narrative
principles.rule: An experiment and the editorial account of that experiment MUST be independently identifiable. Editing a narrative MUST NOT silently rewrite the experimental result.

principles.title: Visibility is multidimensional
principles.rule: Public visibility, source availability, evidence availability, maturity and disclosure MUST NOT be collapsed into one field or one label.

principles.title: Architecture is representation
principles.rule: Architecture records describe responsibilities, boundaries, relationships or invariants. They MUST NOT be treated as proof that the represented system behaves as described.

principles.title: Published URLs are durable identities
principles.rule: Once a public canonical URL is established, a later migration MUST preserve its identity through continued resolution or an explicit durable redirect. Content MUST NOT silently move to a different identity.

principles.title: Revision preserves history
principles.rule: A material correction or constitutional change MUST remain distinguishable from the state that preceded it. Frozen contracts MUST be amended explicitly rather than silently rewritten.

principles.title: Private knowledge cannot leak by composition
principles.rule: A set of individually public records MUST NOT be linked or projected in a way that reconstructs information deliberately withheld by a private or sanitized boundary.

principles.title: UI is not ontology
principles.rule: Cards, sections, pages, tabs, navigation, search results and visual templates are replaceable projections. They MUST NOT define what the underlying records are.

principles.title: Code is not evidence of operation by itself
principles.rule: Public source proves that source is public. It MUST NOT, by itself, be presented as proof of deployment, runtime behavior, production maturity, security review or successful physical execution.

priorityRule: When future implementation choices conflict, preserve public truth, explicit uncertainty, provenance and disclosure boundaries before convenience, aesthetics or marketing value.
